answers.how: Estimated the quadratic downward motion around 0.2 s and calibrated it against the later acceleration, correcting for depth.
Tracked the box along the ramp, fitted its accelerating trajectory, and converted the fitted velocity at 1 s using the acceleration prior.
Used the calibrated ramp-motion fit to estimate the velocity at 1.5 s.
Measured the box’s length edge and converted it using the motion-derived scale with perspective correction.
Measured the box’s height edge, excluding the bow, and applied the calibrated scale and perspective correction.
